critique.good: 六个成绩列等宽，三个学科的期中、期末配对清晰；单科分数、总分和学科名称均保持完整。
critique.problems: 所有姓名都折成两行，使数据行变高，行内成绩与姓名的对应关系也不如单行姓名直观。子表头逐字换行，但在统一列宽下仍有一致的节奏。
critique.cause: 姓名列宽53px，扣除21px后只剩32px，不足以容纳约46px的完整姓名；各成绩列宽42px，内容区仅21px，无法并排容纳期中或期末两个字。

critique.good: 姓名、单科成绩和总分均完整单行显示，数据行紧凑且容易横向阅读；六个等宽成绩列让三个学科和两次考试的比较保持一致。总分列也有足够空间。
critique.problems: 六个子表头都分成两行，阅读时需要纵向组合两个字；不过这种换行在各学科中一致，表头层级仍然清楚。
critique.cause: 姓名列67px和总分列52px恰好分别提供46px和31px内容宽度；每个成绩列40px仅提供19px内容宽度，能容纳分数，但不足以让两个汉字并排。

critique.good: 各学科仍按期中、期末成对排列，单科成绩和总分保持完整。
critique.problems: 姓名和姓名表头逐字换行，六个数据行因此很高，姓名难以快速辨认；成绩列交替宽窄，削弱了同类列的统一节奏。总分列较宽，留白相对过多。
critique.cause: 姓名列51px扣除内边距和边框后仅30px，不足以并排显示两个汉字；成绩列在43px与40px之间交替，总分列占59px，挤占了姓名列所需的空间。

r0A.idea: 六个成绩列等宽，建立均匀的比较节奏；姓名可能换行，子表头利用两层表头的高度换行。

r0B.idea: 优先让姓名完整显示，六个成绩列收紧到仍可容纳两位数的宽度，子表头换行。

r0C.idea: 每科的期中列稍宽、期末列收紧，并为总分留出更多空间，以重复的宽窄节奏区分各学科组。

understanding.purpose: 汇总六名高一学生三科期中、期末成绩及总分，便于查看个人表现和比较成绩。
understanding.reading: 读者按行查看同一学生的成绩和总分，也会按列比较学生，并在每个学科内对照期中与期末。两层表头已有高度，可容纳子表头换行。
groups: 姓名列标识每一行，需让姓名仍容易辨认。
语文、数学、英语各由期中和期末两列组成；六个分数列作用相同，宽度应有一致的节奏。
总分列汇总各科成绩，供读者快速比较整体表现。
may_wrap: 期中、期末子表头可在两个汉字之间换行。
学生姓名可在汉字之间换行，但完整姓名位于同一行高内更易扫描。

bad.why: Every student name wraps onto two lines, making the identifying column harder to scan and stretching all six data rows.
Student names break into three lines and the 姓名 header also wraps. The resulting tall rows scatter each student's scores across too much vertical space.

final.rationale: r0B keeps each student's name and all scores on one line, so each row reads as a clear unit. Equal widths for the six exam columns reinforce their comparable roles, while the wider name column preserves the row identifiers. The 期中 and 期末 headers wrap, but their repeated pattern remains readable under each subject. The ranges describe individual adjustments from r0B, with the total width kept at or below 359px; their upper bounds cannot all be used simultaneously.

general: Give row identifiers enough width to remain intact when readers need them to follow values across a table.
Use consistent widths for columns with equivalent content and roles when the available space permits.
Judge wrapping by its effect on scanning and row rhythm, not by line count alone.
specific: At this font and padding, the name column needs 67px to keep the student names on one line.
The six score columns can be 40px wide while keeping the scores intact; their two-character subheaders wrap.
The 359px limit leaves little room to change widths once names and scores are kept intact.

final.tradeoffs: A designer could give the exam columns more room, but that would require taking space from the name or total column and would disrupt more important content before the subheaders can fit on one line.
final.uncertain: The exact limits of visually equivalent widths are approximate: browser rounding and the preference for equal exam-column widths may make some small asymmetric adjustments less attractive.

A.why: 姓名、成绩和总分均保持完整，六个考试列宽一致，便于横向比较；期中和期末标题分成两行，但分组关系仍然清楚。

B.why: 姓名逐字换行，总分数字也被拆开，破坏了学生与成绩的识别和比较；行高随之显著增加。

C.why: 成绩和总分完整，考试列宽均衡；但每个姓名都被拆成两行，削弱了行标识的可读性。

D.why: 成绩和总分完整，但姓名逐字换行，姓名和总分标题也被拆开；过高的行使横向对应关系更难追踪。

reviews.unsure: 期中和期末标题在 A 中均需换行；在给定宽度和固定内边距下，这是为保持姓名和分数完整所作的取舍。

A.why: Names break into three lines and total scores split across lines, making both student identification and comparison difficult.

B.why: Scores and totals remain intact, but names wrap across two lines and the exam-period headers stack vertically.

C.why: Totals remain intact, but names stack one character per line, making rows unnecessarily tall and student identification harder.

D.why: Names, scores and totals stay intact, with compact rows and balanced subject pairs; the exam-period headers still wrap onto two lines.

reviews.unsure: The exam-period headers wrap in every option shown; the ratings reflect the visible layouts rather than an unshown width allocation.
